title: Multi-Domain ABSA Conversation Dataset Generation via LLMs for Real-World Evaluation and Model Comparison
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical generation and evaluation of an Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) dataset across professional domains (Technology, Healthcare, Finance, and Legal). It uses performance metrics like precision, recall, and F1-score to compare LLM performance and does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
